scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.dev: sh -c 'pnpm run dev:api & API_PID=$!; pnpm --filter @workspace/obra-control run dev; STATUS=$?; kill $API_PID 2>/dev/null || true; wait $API_PID 2>/dev/null || true; exit $STATUS'
scripts.dev:api: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f /vercel/share/.env.project ] && . /vercel/share/.env.project; set +a; PORT=${API_PORT:-8080} exec pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
